newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide cautious on price rise impact. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide cautious on price rise impact. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Monday it would not know until later in the first quarter the impact of price increases in polyethylene and ethylene glycol that were reported last month.
(Corrects from "...price increases that contributed to lower 1996 fourth quarter results")

In a release, the company also said it expected improved 1997 earnings growth for its Specialties and Intermediates segment despite the higher raw material costs, especially for ethane, that hurt its fourth quarter.
